paragraphs: NCIC offers correctional communication and educational services, and its home page frames that work as supporting law enforcement. The platform list names Schoolhouse Educational Tablets, a video and audio calling app, video visitation, mail scanning, messaging, and ticketing. The same page lists Incarcerated Call Engine among the platforms. The site also offers app downloads for iOS and Android devices.

The site speaks directly to people outside the facility, telling a reader who missed a call that someone was trying to make contact from a facility NCIC services. That reader is told to add funds to an account before calls, video visits and messages can be received. Video visits are scheduled ahead of time, and the site says many facilities allow only video visits with detainees.

The mailing address printed on the site is in Longview, Texas. A line at the end of the page names Her Majesty's Prison Bahamas, with nothing nearby saying what that facility's relationship to NCIC is.

quote.text: Many facilities only allow video visits with detainees.
